title: PIDG invests $11.7M in dry waste recycling company NEPRA
summary: Ahmedabad-based NEPRA has built an integrated waste-management and recycling platform that spans the value chain from waste collection and segregation through to material recovery.
llm_summary: PIDG is injecting $11.7 million into NEPRA, an Ahmedabad‑based startup that has built an end‑to‑end waste‑management platform. The company handles everything from on‑site collection and segregation of dry waste to the recovery and sale of recyclable materials, creating a streamlined, technology‑driven supply chain for urban recycling.
